content: Using our models, we present the first fully automated system to extract MR tags from spontaneous doctor-patient conversations. We evaluate the system (using our best performing models) on the transcripts generated from Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) APIs offered by Google and IBM. In Google ASR's transcripts, our best model obtained ROUGE-1 F1 of 71.75 for Dosage extraction (which in this specific case equals to the percentage of times dosage is correct, refer Metrics Section for more details) and 40.13 for Frequency extraction tasks. On qualitative evaluation, we find that for 73.58% of the medications the model can find the correct frequency. These results demonstrate that the research on NLP can be used effectively in a real clinical setting to benefit both doctors and patients
